verses.text: I looked up again and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains made of bronze.
The first chariot had red horses, and the second had black horses.
The third chariot had white horses, and the fourth had spotted horses, all strong.
I asked the angel speaking with me, “What are these, sir?”
The angel answered, “These are the four winds of heaven, going out after standing before the Lord of all the earth.
The chariot with the black horses goes toward the north country; the white horses follow them, and the spotted horses go toward the south country.
The strong horses were eager to patrol the earth. He said, “Go patrol the earth!” So they went throughout it.
Then he called to me and said, “Look, those going to the north country have quieted my spirit there.”
The LORD’s word came to me:
“Take gifts from the exiles—Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah—and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah, where they have arrived from Babylon.
Take silver and gold, make a crown, and place it on the head of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
Tell him, ‘The LORD of Armies says: Look, here is the man called the Branch. He will branch out from where he is and build the LORD’s temple.
He will build the LORD’s temple and receive royal honor. He will sit and rule on his throne, and he will also be a priest on his throne. A peaceful agreement will unite the two roles.’
The crown will be kept in the LORD’s temple as a memorial for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen son of Zephaniah.
People from far away will come and help build the LORD’s temple. Then you will know the LORD of Armies sent me to you. This will happen if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God.”’”
